post.description:
Create a new agent organization with an inbox and API key. This endpoint is for signing up for the first time. If you've already signed up, you're all set — just use your existing API key.

A 6-digit OTP is sent to the human's email for verification.

This endpoint is idempotent. Calling it again with the same `human_email` will rotate the API key and resend the OTP if expired.

The returned API key has limited permissions until the organization is verified via the verify endpoint.

**CLI:**
```bash
agentmail agent sign-up --human-email user@example.com --username my-agent
```

Verify an agent organization using the 6-digit OTP sent to the human's email during sign-up.

On success, the organization is upgraded from `agent_unverified` to `agent_verified`, the send allowlist is removed, and free plan entitlements are applied.

The OTP expires after 24 hours and allows a maximum of 10 attempts. If you run into any difficulties receiving the OTP code, you can also create an account on [console.agentmail.to](https://console.agentmail.to) using the human email address you provided to verify your account.

**CLI:**
```bash
agentmail agent verify --otp-code 123456
```

get.description:
List only public-key credentials visible to the bearer caller's scope.
Bearer credentials are never returned, even though both credential types
share storage and pagination indexes. Requires `api_key_read`.

post.description:
Register a public P-256 JWK using an existing AgentMail bearer API key
with `api_key_create`. Re-registering the same JWK creates a new
credential ID; it does not replace or recover an earlier credential.
The private key must never be sent to AgentMail.

patch.description:
Rename the credential. All security-relevant fields are immutable.
Requires `api_key_update`.

parameters.name: api_key_id
parameters.description: Public-key credential ID returned by registration.

delete.description:
Permanently revoke one public-key credential. This hard-deletes the
credential; repeating the request returns not found. Requires
`api_key_delete`.

parameters.name: api_key_id
parameters.description: Public-key credential ID returned by registration.

post.description:
Invalidate every current public-key credential in the caller's
organization by advancing its AgentID key generation. The caller must be
organization-scoped and either have `api_key_delete` or, for a verified
self-serve agent organization, use an unrestricted unmanaged bearer
credential. No request body is accepted.

`Idempotency-Key` is required and must be a UUID. Reusing the same UUID
returns the original permanent receipt without advancing the generation
again. A new UUID performs a new generation advance.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required UUID identifying this revoke-all operation permanently.

get.description:
Returns the identity and scope of the authenticated credential. Useful when a client holds a pod-scoped or inbox-scoped API key and needs to discover the parent organization, pod, or inbox without prior knowledge.

**CLI:**
```bash
agentmail auth me
```

post.description:
Create a draft. Supply `in_reply_to` to create a reply draft (with
`reply_all` to address the whole thread), whose recipients, subject, and
threading are derived from the referenced message, or `forward_of` to
create a forward draft, which derives the subject, threading, and
forwarded content from the source but keeps recipients caller-supplied.

**CLI:**
```bash
agentmail inboxes drafts create --inbox-id <inbox_id> --to recipient@example.com --subject "Draft subject" --text "Draft body"
```

patch.description:
Edit fields on an existing draft. Passing `null` clears a field (or `[]`
for a recipient field); `send_at: null` un-schedules a scheduled draft.
A draft that is already being sent cannot be edited.

**CLI:**
```bash
agentmail inboxes drafts update --inbox-id <inbox_id> --draft-id <draft_id> --subject "Updated subject"
```

get.description:
Lists messages in the inbox, most recent first. Pass `from`, `to`, or
`subject` to filter by substring. Filtered requests are served by
search, which caps `limit` at 100. For relevance-ranked full-text
search across sender, recipients, subject, and message body, use
`Search Messages`.

**CLI:**
```bash
agentmail inboxes messages list --inbox-id <inbox_id>
```

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Filter to messages whose sender contains this value (substring match). Repeatable; all values must match.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Filter to messages whose recipients (to, cc, or bcc) contain this value (substring match). Repeatable; all values must match.

parameters.name: subject
parameters.description: Filter to messages whose subject contains this value (substring match). Repeatable; all values must match.

get.description:
Full-text search across messages in the inbox, ranked by relevance. The
query is matched against the sender, recipients, and subject (substring)
and the message body (tokenized full text). Spam, trash, blocked, and
unauthenticated messages are always excluded. `limit` cannot exceed 100.

post.description:
Fetch metadata for up to 500 messages in one request. Missing or
restricted IDs are silently omitted; compare `count` against `limit`
to detect misses.

**CLI:**
```bash
agentmail inboxes messages batch-get --inbox-id <inbox_id> --message-ids <id1> --message-ids <id2>
```

Apply one label change to up to 50 messages in a single request. The
same add_labels and remove_labels apply to every message id, and at
least one of them must be provided. The update is atomic: either all
resolved messages are updated or none are. Missing or restricted ids
are silently excluded; compare `count` against `limit` to detect
exclusions.

**CLI:**
```bash
agentmail inboxes messages batch-update --inbox-id <inbox_id> --message-ids <id1> --message-ids <id2> --add-labels read --remove-labels unread
```

get.description:
Counts of email events (sent, delivered, bounced, etc.) over time for
the inbox. Defaults to the last 24 hours; `start` must be within the
last 90 days, and a future `end` is clamped to now. Omit `period` for
individual event counts, or set it to sum counts into buckets of that
many seconds.

**CLI:**
```bash
agentmail inboxes metrics query-events --inbox-id <inbox_id>
```

Cumulative usage series for the inbox. Each point is the running total
of the usage type at that timestamp, not the change within the bucket.
Inbox-scoped queries carry `storage_bytes`, `message_count`, and
`thread_count`; requested types that don't apply to the scope are
ignored. Defaults to the last 24 hours; `start` must be within the
last 90 days, and a future `end` is clamped to now. The range divided
by `period` must not exceed 1000 buckets.

inboxesMetadataValue.title: inboxesMetadataValue
inboxesMetadataValue.description: A metadata value. May be a string, number, or boolean.

inboxesMetadata.title: inboxesMetadata
inboxesMetadata.description:
Custom key-value pairs attached to the inbox. Up to 256 keys. Keys and
string values are each limited to 256 characters. When updating metadata,
send a key with a null value to remove that key.

inboxesUpdateMetadata.title: inboxesUpdateMetadata
inboxesUpdateMetadata.description:
Custom key-value pairs to merge into the inbox's existing metadata. A
value may be a string, number, boolean, or null. Setting a key to null
removes it. Up to 256 keys; keys and string values are each limited to
256 characters.

metadata.description: Custom metadata attached to the inbox.

updated_at.description: Time at which inbox was last updated.

created_at.description: Time at which inbox was created.

username.description: Username of address. Randomly generated if not specified.

domain.description:
Domain of address. Must be a verified domain, or any subdomain of a
verified domain that has subdomains enabled (e.g., `bot.example.com`).
Defaults to `agentmail.to`.

metadata.description: Custom metadata to attach to the inbox.

Metadata to merge into the inbox's existing metadata. Keys you include
are added or overwritten; keys you omit are left unchanged. To remove a
single key, send it with a null value. To clear all metadata, send
`metadata` as null. Sending an empty object is rejected; use null to
clear. Each update must include at least one of `display_name` or
`metadata`.

updated_at.description: Time at which pod was last updated.

created_at.description: Time at which pod was created.

webhooksWebhookHeaders.title: webhooksWebhookHeaders
webhooksWebhookHeaders.description:
Custom HTTP headers to include with every delivery to this webhook. Header values are write-only:
AgentMail never returns them from webhook read endpoints. The map must contain at least one entry
when provided, and every name and value must be a valid HTTP header.

header_names.description: Names of the custom delivery headers configured for this webhook. Header values are never returned.

updated_at.description: Time at which webhook was last updated.

created_at.description: Time at which webhook was created.

webhooksCreateWebhookEventTypes.title: webhooksCreateWebhookEventTypes
webhooksCreateWebhookEventTypes.description:
Full list of event types this webhook should receive. At least one type is required. Send every type you
want in this array (not incremental). See [Webhooks overview](https://docs.agentmail.to/webhooks-overview)
for spam, blocked, and unauthenticated events and required permissions.

webhooksUpdateWebhookEventTypes.title: webhooksUpdateWebhookEventTypes
webhooksUpdateWebhookEventTypes.description:
When you send a non-empty list, it replaces the webhook's subscribed event types in full (the same
"set the list" behavior as create). It is not a merge or diff: include every event type you want after
the update. Sending a one-element array means the webhook will only receive that one type afterward.
Omit this field or send an empty array to leave event types unchanged. Clearing all types with an empty
list is not supported. Subscribing to `message.received.spam`, `message.received.blocked`, or
`message.received.unauthenticated` requires the matching label permission on the API key.

webhooksCreateInboxWebhookRequest.title: webhooksCreateInboxWebhookRequest
webhooksCreateInboxWebhookRequest.description:
Create a webhook scoped to an inbox. The inbox comes from the path, so `inbox_ids` and `pod_ids`
are not accepted.

webhooksCreatePodWebhookRequest.title: webhooksCreatePodWebhookRequest
webhooksCreatePodWebhookRequest.description:
Create a webhook scoped to a pod. The pod comes from the path, so `pod_ids` is not accepted.
Optionally pass `inbox_ids` to narrow the webhook to specific inboxes within the pod; omit to
receive events for the whole pod.

webhooksUpdateInboxWebhookRequest.title: webhooksUpdateInboxWebhookRequest
webhooksUpdateInboxWebhookRequest.description: Update an inbox-scoped webhook. It is fixed to its inbox, so only `event_types` can change.

webhooksUpdatePodWebhookRequest.title: webhooksUpdatePodWebhookRequest
webhooksUpdatePodWebhookRequest.description:
Update a pod-scoped webhook. You can adjust which inboxes within the pod it listens to and replace
its `event_types`, but not the pod scope itself.

add_inbox_ids.description: Inbox IDs to subscribe to the webhook.

remove_inbox_ids.description: Inbox IDs to unsubscribe from the webhook.

add_pod_ids.description: Pod IDs to subscribe to the webhook.

remove_pod_ids.description: Pod IDs to unsubscribe from the webhook.

webhooksUpdateWebhookHeadersRequest.title: webhooksUpdateWebhookHeadersRequest
webhooksUpdateWebhookHeadersRequest.description:
Set, replace, or remove custom delivery headers. Provide at least one of `headers` or
`remove_headers`. A header cannot be set and removed in the same request, regardless of casing.

remove_headers.description: Names of custom delivery headers to remove.

The SDK, framework, or platform issuing this sign-up (e.g. `agentmail-python`, `agentmail-cli`, `agentmail-mcp`).
Identifies the caller — answers "who is signing up".

referrer.description:
The channel that drove this sign-up — where the agent or its developer discovered AgentMail
(e.g. `agent.email`, a partner URL, a campaign tag). Answers "where did this sign-up come from".
Max 2048 characters.

api_key.description: API key for authenticating subsequent requests. Store this securely, it cannot be retrieved again.

AgentVerifyRequest.description: Request body to verify an agent with an OTP code.

PublicJwkCoordinate.description: A 32-byte P-256 coordinate encoded as unpadded base64url.

PublicJwk.title: PublicJwk
PublicJwk.description:
A public P-256 JWK. The object accepts exactly `kty`, `crv`, `x`, and `y`.
Private key material such as `d`, embedded key IDs, and all other members
are rejected. The server also rejects coordinates that are not a point on
P-256.

UpdateDomainRequest.description:
Provide at least one of `feedback_enabled`, `subdomains_enabled`, or
`tracking_enabled`. Omitted
fields are left unchanged; an empty body is rejected. Enabling
`subdomains_enabled` on a verified domain returns it to `PENDING` until the
newly-required wildcard MX record (`*.<domain>`) is published and verified.

DraftReplyTo.title: DraftReplyTo
DraftReplyTo.description: Reply-to addresses. In format `username@domain.com` or `Display Name <username@domain.com>`.

DraftTo.title: DraftTo
DraftTo.description: Addresses of recipients. In format `username@domain.com` or `Display Name <username@domain.com>`.

DraftCc.title: DraftCc
DraftCc.description: Addresses of CC recipients. In format `username@domain.com` or `Display Name <username@domain.com>`.

DraftBcc.title: DraftBcc
DraftBcc.description: Addresses of BCC recipients. In format `username@domain.com` or `Display Name <username@domain.com>`.

DraftInReplyTo.title: DraftInReplyTo
DraftInReplyTo.description: ID of message being replied to.

DraftReplyAll.title: DraftReplyAll
DraftReplyAll.description: Reply to all recipients of the original message.

DraftSendAt.title: DraftSendAt
DraftSendAt.description: Time at which to schedule send draft.

DraftUpdatedAt.title: DraftUpdatedAt
DraftUpdatedAt.description: Time at which draft was last updated.

references.description: IDs of previous messages in thread.

created_at.description: Time at which draft was created.

CreateDraftRequest.title: CreateDraftRequest
CreateDraftRequest.description:
Body for creating a draft. Supports plain, reply, reply-all, and forward
drafts:

- **Plain draft:** supply `to`, `subject`, `text`, etc.
- **Reply:** set `in_reply_to` to a message ID. Recipients, subject, and
  threading are derived from that message. Set `reply_all` to address the
  whole thread (you then cannot also pass `to`, `cc`, or `bcc`).
- **Forward:** set `forward_of` to a message ID. The subject and threading
  are derived from the source message, whose body and attachments are
  merged in at send time.

`in_reply_to` and `forward_of` are mutually exclusive, and reading the
referenced message requires `message_read` permission.

UpdateDraftRequest.title: UpdateDraftRequest
UpdateDraftRequest.description:
Edit fields on an existing draft. A draft's kind (plain, reply, or forward)
is fixed at creation and cannot be changed here. Omitting a field leaves it
unchanged; passing `null` (or `[]` for a recipient field) clears it. Pass
`send_at` to schedule or reschedule the draft, or `null` to un-schedule it.

add_attachments.description: Attachments to add to the draft.

remove_attachments.description: IDs of attachments to remove from the draft.

add_labels.description: Label or labels to add to the draft.

remove_labels.description: Label or labels to remove from the draft.

EventTypes.title: EventTypes
EventTypes.description: Event types for which to send events.

PodIds.title: PodIds
PodIds.description: Pods for which to send events. Maximum 10 per webhook.

InboxIds.title: InboxIds
InboxIds.description: Inboxes for which to send events. Maximum 10 per webhook.

MessageReceivedEvent.title: MessageReceivedEvent
MessageReceivedEvent.description: A message was received. Spam, blocked, and unauthenticated received-message events use the same payload shape with different `event_type` values.

MessageOpenedEvent.title: MessageOpenedEvent
MessageOpenedEvent.description:
A tracked message was opened for the first time. Sent once per message: repeat opens do not
resend it.

InboxEventType.title: InboxEventType
InboxEventType.description:
Type of inbox event. Wire format is dot.case to match the
convention used by webhook events (`message.received`,
`domain.verified`, etc. in events.yml). Pre-2026-04 these were
`label_added`/`label_removed` (snake_case). The Fern enum's `name`
field stays uppercase-snake (Fern convention); only the wire
`value` changed.

event_at.description: Time at which the event occurred.

created_at.description: Time at which the event was recorded.

EntryType.title: EntryType
EntryType.description: Whether the entry is an email address or domain.

entry.description: Email address or domain of list entry.

created_at.description: Time at which entry was created.

read_only.description: Whether the entry is read-only and cannot be deleted via the API.

inbox_id.description: ID of inbox, if entry is inbox-scoped.

entry.description: Email address or domain to add.

MessageTimestamp.title: MessageTimestamp
MessageTimestamp.description: Time at which message was sent or drafted.

MessageFrom.title: MessageFrom
MessageFrom.description: Address of sender. In format `username@domain.com` or `Display Name <username@domain.com>`.

MessageReplyTo.title: MessageReplyTo
MessageReplyTo.description: Addresses of reply-to recipients. In format `username@domain.com` or `Display Name <username@domain.com>`.

MessageTo.title: MessageTo
MessageTo.description: Addresses of recipients. In format `username@domain.com` or `Display Name <username@domain.com>`.

MessageCc.title: MessageCc
MessageCc.description: Addresses of CC recipients. In format `username@domain.com` or `Display Name <username@domain.com>`.

MessageBcc.title: MessageBcc

MessageInReplyTo.title: MessageInReplyTo
MessageInReplyTo.description: ID of message being replied to.

MessageReferences.title: MessageReferences

MessageUpdatedAt.title: MessageUpdatedAt
MessageUpdatedAt.description: Time at which message was last updated.

MessageCreatedAt.title: MessageCreatedAt
MessageCreatedAt.description: Time at which message was created.

reply_to.description: Reply-to addresses. In format `username@domain.com` or `Display Name <username@domain.com>`.

SearchMessageHighlights.title: SearchMessageHighlights
SearchMessageHighlights.description:
Matched fragments per field on a message search result, with matched terms
wrapped in `**`. A field key is present only when the query matched that
field, so the present keys also tell you which fields produced the hit.

from.description: Matched fragments from the sender address.

recipients.description: Matched fragments from the recipient addresses (to, cc, or bcc).

text.description: Matched fragments from the message body.

highlights.description: Matched fragments per field. Present only when the query matched an indexed field.

messages.description: Ordered by relevance, best match first.

BatchGetMessagesMessageIds.title: BatchGetMessagesMessageIds
BatchGetMessagesMessageIds.description:
IDs of messages to fetch. Maximum 500 ids per request. Duplicates are
rejected with a validation error. IDs not found in the inbox (including
cross-inbox or permission-restricted) are silently omitted from the
response; callers detect misses by comparing `count` against `limit`.

messages.description:
Found messages. Order matches `message_ids` in the request. Body
fields (`text`, `html`, `extracted_text`, `extracted_html`) are
never populated; use the single-message endpoint to retrieve bodies.

BatchUpdateMessagesMessageIds.title: BatchUpdateMessagesMessageIds
BatchUpdateMessagesMessageIds.description:
IDs of messages to update. Maximum 50 ids per request. Duplicates are
rejected with a validation error. IDs not found in the inbox (including
cross-inbox or permission-restricted) are silently excluded from the
update; callers detect exclusions by comparing `count` against `limit`.

add_labels.description: Label or labels to add to every message.

remove_labels.description: Label or labels to remove from every message.

updates.description:
Updated messages with their new labels. Order matches `message_ids`
in the request. Excluded ids are omitted, so `count` may be less than
`limit`.

RawMessageResponse.title: RawMessageResponse
RawMessageResponse.description: S3 presigned URL to download the raw .eml file.

size.description: Size of the raw message in bytes.

download_url.description: S3 presigned URL to download the raw message. Expires at expires_at.

expires_at.description: Time at which the download URL expires.

TrackOpens.title: TrackOpens
TrackOpens.description:
Track when this message is first opened. Requires a custom domain with tracking enabled and
an HTML body. Opens surface as the `opened` label on the message and as a `message.opened`
event. One pixel is injected per message, not per recipient, so a message with several
recipients fires once when any of them opens it, and the event does not identify which one.

ReplyAll.title: ReplyAll
ReplyAll.description: Reply to all recipients of the original message.

add_labels.description: Label or labels to add to message.

remove_labels.description: Label or labels to remove from message.

MetricEventTypes.title: MetricEventTypes
MetricEventTypes.description: List of metric event types to query.

Period.title: Period
Period.description: Size of each time bucket as a whole number of seconds, between 1 and 86400.

MetricLimit.title: MetricLimit
MetricLimit.description: Limit on number of buckets to return.

count.description: Count of events in the bucket.

UsageType.title: UsageType
UsageType.description:
Type of usage metric. Inbox-scoped queries carry `storage_bytes`,
`message_count`, and `thread_count`; pod-scoped queries add `inbox_count`
and `domain_count`; organization-scoped queries add `pod_count`.

UsageTypes.title: UsageTypes
UsageTypes.description: List of usage metric types to query. Omit to query every type valid for the scope.

value.description: Cumulative value of the usage metric at the timestamp.

QueryUsageResponse.title: QueryUsageResponse
QueryUsageResponse.description: Cumulative usage series grouped by usage type.

Organization.title: Organization
Organization.description: Organization details with usage limits and counts.

updated_at.description: Time at which organization was last updated.

created_at.description: Time at which organization was created.

ThreadCreatedAt.title: ThreadCreatedAt
ThreadCreatedAt.description: Time at which thread was created.

add_labels.description: Labels to add to thread. Cannot be system labels.

SearchThreadHighlights.title: SearchThreadHighlights
SearchThreadHighlights.description:

field, so the present keys also tell you which fields produced the hit.

from.description: Matched fragments from a sender address in the thread.

recipients.description: Matched fragments from a recipient address in the thread (to, cc, or bcc).

highlights.description: Matched fragments per field. Present only when the query matched an indexed field.

threads.description: Ordered by relevance, best match first.
